text: On start, the orange intro message (line 2: 'The NEXT line top left says what comes next') is drawn over the help block's first line 'W A S D walk ... E use', making both unreadable.
After throwing 3 pots at the wheel, no pot appears on or near the wheel in view; the NEXT line says they are 4 m behind me to the right. A new player wonders whether the throw worked.

Standing on the ghat steps from 5:27 to 6:01 pm (34 in-game minutes) the NEXT line stays 'Wait on the ghat steps for the sunset' with no countdown, no 'you sit' message, and E does nothing. A player cannot tell whether they are in the right spot or how long remains.

After the first snake resolves into a rope, the NEXT line reads 'Go closer with the lamp, then look at it steadily (1' and is cut off at the right edge of the 640x360 window; the counter in parentheses is unreadable. Also it says '6 m ahead' while the rope I just looked at sits right under the crosshair - unclear whether it refers to the same rope or another.
Next to a lamp-lit house wall the white HUD text (NEXT, CHORES, stats) is drawn over bright yellow wall with no backing, and becomes hard to read.

After E at the door ('You sleep, and dream.') the world turns grey and the HUD clock runs BACKWARDS (6:56 pm -> 6:03 -> 4:33 -> 2:46 pm over ~45 game seconds). NEXT says only 'Nothing here seems strange'; walking, E and C do nothing. No hint how to wake or what to do; ~6 minutes wall-clock with no progress. Expected: a NEXT instruction or the dream to end and morning to come.

Woke on 22 March 7:07 am after the dream rewound to dawn-ish. NEXT: 'Nothing more is asked of you'; 'Living  step back and watch (V)'. Morning reached about 13 min wall-clock (~100 game seconds) after sleeping; the dream had no visible way to speed it up.

Pressing V (step back and watch) at first placed the camera inside/behind a house wall: half the screen was a flat grey slab (see shots/v1.png). After ~3 s the camera settled behind the figure, who then walks on its own - a lovely moment once visible.
